summary: v135.40 testing (iteration 53). BACKEND retry policy: fully verified with 6 new pytest cases calling check_and_fire_due_schedules() directly against live Mongo (motor) — cycle1 attempts=1 + next_retry_at ~+1min + last_error, cycle2 attempts=2 + ~+5min, cycle3 attempts=3 + sent=true + abandoned=true + next_retry_at unset; future next_retry_at rows are SKIPPED; next_retry_at=null + past send_at is picked up; future send_at not fired; success path -> attempts=1, next_retry_at unset, fired_at/target_count set; GET /rsvp-schedules exposes attempts/next_retry_at/last_error/abandoned with no _id. Regression (iter50+51+52): 50 passed / 1 failed (the iter52 60s-loop fire test, flaky — passed on isolated rerun). FRONTEND: /sablonlar RSVP retry chip ('⟳ Deneme 2/3 · sonraki deneme: 18:15:13') and abandoned chip ('✗ Vazgeçildi (3 deneme) · 404: template not found') render correctly. /etkinlikler 'Şablondan' dropdown renders row + single-pick + Seri areas; tpl-series-modal opens with all 6 presets, start-date, interval, count, live preview (weekly4 -> 4 dates 7d apart; count edit + interval change flip preset to Özel; monthly x3 -> +1 month steps). BLOCKING DEFECT: submitting the series creates only ONE event — POST /api/events silently drops recurrence_interval/recurrence_count because EventCreate does not declare them, so the series feature does not work end-to-end.

critical.issue: EventCreate (server.py:238-277) has NO recurrence_interval / recurrence_count fields, so body.model_dump() never contains them -> create_event() sees interval='none', count=1. Result: recurrence_created=1, series_id=null, only 1 event inserted. Verified by direct curl-equivalent (weekly x4 -> 1 event) AND via UI (daily x7 -> toast '1 etkinlik oluşturuldu'). This breaks the new 'Şablondan Seri' feature AND the pre-existing EventForm 'Tekrarla' on create (Events.jsx:2793). Fix: add `recurrence_interval: Optional[str] = None` + `recurrence_count: Optional[int] = None` to EventCreate (EventUpdate already has them, which is why PATCH recurrence works).

server.py:1205 step map only supports {'2days':2,'weekly':7,'2weekly':14} + monthly. The new TemplateSeriesModal sends 'daily' (Günlük × 7 gün preset) which is NOT in the map -> even after fixing EventCreate, daily series will silently create 1 event. Add 'daily':1 to the map (and/or align the FE interval options with the backend set 2days/weekly/2weekly/monthly).

minor.issue: No atomic claim before send (still no findOneAndUpdate); with >1 worker the same schedule could be fired twice. Pre-existing note from iteration 52, unchanged.
New query filters on next_retry_at but ensure_rsvp_templates_indexes only indexes (sent, send_at). Low impact at current volume; consider adding next_retry_at to the compound index.

ui_bugs.issue: While the SWR '/event-templates' request is in flight, `data?.items || []` is empty so the dropdown flashes the misleading empty state 'Kayıtlı şablon yok. /sablonlar sayfasından ekleyebilirsin.' (reproduced: 0 rows at +500ms, 1 row at +3s). Add a loading state for `data === undefined`.

`const spawned = res?.data?.recurrence_created || n;` — the `|| n` fallback would report the requested count as created even when the backend created fewer/none. Should surface the server value and warn when spawned !== n.
Interval select offers daily/weekly/monthly only; backend also supports 2days/2weekly and does NOT support daily — the option set is out of sync with the API contract.

integration_issues.issue: End-to-end broken: weekly×4 and daily×7 both produced exactly ONE event. Modal closes, toast shows, /events + /stats SWR keys are revalidated correctly, so the only failure point is the backend dropping recurrence_* (see backend critical #1/#2).

issues: No visual issues found — presets grid, selected-preset highlight (aria-pressed + pink border), preview list contrast and submit button all look correct at 1920x1080.
Retry chip (#FCD34D) and abandoned chip (#FCA5A5) both readable on the dark/red row backgrounds; abandoned row correctly tinted red with 'Vazgeçildi' badge.

action_items: CRITICAL: add recurrence_interval + recurrence_count to EventCreate in /app/backend/server.py (~line 270) — without it 'Şablondan Seri' creates 1 event instead of N.
Add 'daily': 1 to the recurrence step_days map at server.py:1205 (or drop the daily7 preset / switch it to 2days) so the Günlük × 7 gün preset actually spawns 7 events.
Remove the `|| n` fallback in TemplateSeriesModal toast and warn when recurrence_created !== requested count.
Add a loading state to the template quick-pick dropdown so 'Kayıtlı şablon yok' is not flashed while /event-templates is loading.

Optional: relax the iteration_52 TestSchedulerFire wait from 100s to ~150s (or call check_and_fire_due_schedules directly like test_iter53_retry.py) — the 60s loop timer resets on every backend hot reload, which makes it flaky.
critical_code_review_comments: The FE↔BE contract for recurrence is unvalidated on both sides: EventCreate silently ignores unknown keys (Pydantic default) and create_event silently no-ops for unknown intervals. Add `model_config = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')` on EventCreate (or explicit Literal validation on recurrence_interval) so this class of bug 422s instead of silently creating one event.

check_and_fire_due_schedules still compares ISO strings lexicographically for send_at AND now next_retry_at; both are written with datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() so it works today, but any row with a 'Z' suffix or non-UTC offset (e.g. hand-inserted, or an older migration) will sort wrong and either never fire or fire early. Store BSON dates.

Abandonment reuses `sent=True` as the 'stop polling' flag, so /rsvp-schedules?include_sent=false hides abandoned failures and the list ordering treats them as sent. Consider a dedicated `state` field (pending|sent|abandoned) — the UI already needs abandoned as a separate visual state.
Events.jsx is now 4143 lines (TemplateSeriesModal + TemplateQuickPickButton appended at module scope). Split into src/components/events/* before the next feature.

rca_of_the_issue: Şablondan Seri creates one event because the recurrence knobs never reach create_event(): FastAPI validates the body against EventCreate, which does not declare recurrence_interval/recurrence_count, and Pydantic v2's default extra='ignore' drops them. server.py:1175-1176 therefore reads interval='none', count=1, series_id stays None and a single document is inserted; the endpoint still returns 200 with recurrence_created=1, so the UI shows a success toast ('1 etkinlik oluşturuldu') and looks healthy. Repro: POST /api/events {name,date,recurrence_interval:'weekly',recurrence_count:4} -> recurrence_created=1, GET /api/events shows 1 matching row. Secondary defect: even with the model fixed, interval 'daily' is absent from the step map at server.py:1205, so the daily7 preset would still create 1 event.
